details.233:
Sales Coordinator  

  • Department : Sales
  • Designation : Sales Coordinator
  • Open Positions : 2 Position
  • Location : Mumbai
  • Gender : Female/ Male
  • Work Experience : 2+ years
Key Skills
  • Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Ability to analyse data and prepare dashboards based on that.
  • Attention to detail and accuracy in handling sales documents.
  • Excellent telephonic skills with strong follow up.

Role & Responsibility

  1. Inside Sales / Cold Calling.
  2. Coordinate and follow up with clients on sales leads, ensuring timely responses and effective communication.
  3. Build and maintain long-term customer relationships.
  4. Prepare and present detailed and accurate sales reports.
  5. Address customer queries and complaints via calls and emails.
  6. Maintain updated records of all important customer information in the database.
  7. Handle urgent requests and queries in a timely manner.
  8. Maintain organized sales records and report month-end goals to the Sales Head.
  9. Arrange for the creation and distribution of presentations and supporting documents to assist the sales team.
details.602:
Sales - Business Development Manager

  • Department : Sales
  • Designation : Business Development Manager
  • Open Positions : 5
  • Location : Delhi, Nagpur, MP/Gujarat, Pune & South Region
  • Gender : Male / Female
  • Work Experience : 5+ years
Key Skills
  • Require good experience in sales of large IT solutions/services within the Banking and Financial Services Industry
  • Knowledge of the Banking and Financial industry
  • Expertise in software sales to BFSI (preferred Banking) customers
  • New business development
  • BFSI domain knowledge
  • Identify new/potential needs of clients
  • Help the sales team up-sell or cross-sell services and products
  • Exposure to consultative software sales to BFSI is desirable

Role & Responsibility

  • Identifies business opportunities by identifying prospects and evaluating their position in the industry; researching and analyzing sales options.
  • Handling the responsibility of IT software sales/solutions to banking, NBFC, or financial sector clients.
  • Sells banking products by establishing contact and developing relationships with prospects; recommending solutions.
  • Handling existing clients and evaluating sales opportunities for new clients.
  • Ensuring sales targets and KPI targets are achieved.
  • Designing and implementing the highest standards of customer service and satisfaction across all areas of business.
  • Data gathering of competitors, products, and benchmarking.
